Use it over a whole partition, as aft_augment_by does. With the options of aft_fit_agg.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | NULL    | [aft_augment_agg(duration, [x1, x2], event, {'distribution': 'lognormal'}) OVER ()]                                                                                      |

'hc_type': 'hc0' (default) or 'hc1', 'cadjust' (default false, as survreg); with priors the penalized bread is used. compute_inference defaults to true.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | NULL    | [aft_fit_agg(duration, [x1, x2], event, patient_id, MAP {})]                                                                                                             |
